timeline.body: I think it's not worthy to introduce a dedicated `@ConfigurationProperties` bean for now.

reply.body: I'd prefer a `@ConfigurationProperties` bean with a single property over hand-written metadata. I also think the property should be named `spring.validation.method.adapt-constraint-violations`.

timeline.body: Is it correct adding it to `Core Properties`?

reply.body: Yes, I think that's the best of the existing groupings.

timeline.message:
Add spring.validation.method.adapt-constraint-violations property

Closes GH-43881
